info.title: NAPL API
info.description: Authoritative local contract for the consolidated trusted GraphQL dispatcher and retained REST workflows, including managed Supabase Storage. No compatibility aliases. Runtime verification is enforced by repository contract tests; this document makes no deployment claim.

servers.description: Local API default port3000; default bind host127.0.0.1 (api/plugins/cfg.ts and api/dev.ts).

options.description:
Fastify route * matches arbitrary multi-segment paths; OpenAPI uses /{corsPath} as a documented wildcard placeholder, not a one-segment-only runtime restriction. Valid preflight requires Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method. Strict preflight with Origin but no request method returns400 text/plain. Wrong Origin returns403 JSON. No Origin disables CORS and continues normal auth/routing, which can return401 for protected /api paths or404. This route is not a general-purpose application endpoint.

Authorization policy from supplied specification: Preflight stops before auth; absent Origin continues auth/routing..
options.x-auth: Preflight stops before auth; absent Origin continues auth/routing.

parameters.name: corsPath
parameters.description: Entire wildcard path, including any / separators.

parameters.name: Access-Control-Request-Method
parameters.description: Required for a valid preflight. Browser checks the allowed methods emitted by the server.

400.description: Strict preflight missing Access-Control-Request-Method; plain text. Other middleware failures may be JSON.

401.description: Without Origin, ordinary protected API authentication may reject the request.

404.description: Without Origin, wildcard handler delegates to normal not-found routing.
